title: A component with useQuery
prompt: Create `src/PetCard.tsx` that exports `function PetCard(props: { $api: OpenapiQueryClient<paths>; petId: number })` (`OpenapiQueryClient` from openapi-typesafe-react-query). It loads the pet with `props.$api.useQuery` for `GET /pets/{petId}` and renders `Loading…` while the pet loads, the pet name in an `<h2>` when it is loaded, and `Pet not found` when the request failed.
